Background Remover, vendored third-party components
====================================================

ONNX Runtime Web 1.20.1 (ort.min.js, ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm,
ort-wasm-simd-threaded.js, the last renamed from .mjs because this host
serves .mjs as text/plain)
License: MIT License, Microsoft Corporation.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web (v1.20.1)

Background removal model (model.onnx)
The "silueta" model: a compact U^2-Net variant distributed with the
rembg project (https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg, MIT License),
from the U^2-Net project by Xuebin Qin et al.
(https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net).
License: Apache License 2.0.
Model file: silueta.onnx from rembg release v0.0.0, 44,173,029 bytes,
unmodified.
